quote: Equipping large language models (LLMs) with tool use capabilities allows them to overcome their limitations by accessing external or up-to-date information, domain-specific knowledge, and advanced specialized functionalities, thereby enabling them to handle more complex tasks beyond their inherent abilities.
outputs: The generated outputs include decisions (Yes/No) on tool use or retrieval, explanations for those decisions, and responses to user queries with or without external tool invocation.

quote: The primary evaluation metric is decision accuracy—whether the model correctly identifies when external tools/RAG are genuinely necessary.

The primary evaluation metric is decision accuracy—whether the model correctly identifies when external tools/RAG are genuinely necessary. Additional metrics such as precision and recall are reported in the appendix.
